name: Social Clicker: Persona
storyline: A young designer, currently without any freelance work, receives an offer from a young woman to work as her social media manager, helping to grow her Instagram. As his work progresses, he is introduced to an adult content app, where he starts making money and advancing in his career. However, a mystery emerges in his dreams, completely altering his perception of reality and causing new personas to surface in his life. His challenge is to guide the characters to a successful conclusion, facing these enigmas and uncovering the truth behind them. Live an intense life and embark on a beautiful story full of twists and turns.
summary: You are a young person who starts working as a social media manager with a young woman to grow her online presence.
